results.name: ConsciousRide
results.text:
it’s probably a mix of multiple things, not only ai alone

many layoffs happened because of:
- over hiring during the zero interest rate boom
- cost cutting pressure
- slowing growth
- post pandemic corrections
- investor pressure for profitability
- automation improvements including ai

at the same time, many of these companies are still hiring selectively in areas like ai, infra, cloud, security, and platform engineering even after layoffs
